lines.en: Even the abyss has an end.

lines.zh: 在远比群星一生更漫长的岁月里，
lines.en: Over ages far longer than the lives of the stars,

lines.zh: 黑洞也将以极其微弱的辐射，缓缓流失自身。
lines.en: the black holes too will slowly bleed themselves away in the faintest of radiation.

lines.zh: 倘若还有旅人能够走到那样遥远的年代，
lines.en: If any traveler can still reach so distant an age,

lines.zh: 在日益稀薄的能量中，一次醒来、一场交谈，
lines.en: then in ever-thinner energy, a single waking, a single conversation,

lines.zh: 都可能隔着我们无法想象的岁月。
lines.en: may lie across spans of time we cannot imagine.

lines.zh: 它们放慢思考，像冬眠的动物那样，把每一点能量留给下一次睁眼。
lines.en: They slow their thinking, like animals in hibernation, saving every scrap of energy for the next time they open their eyes.

lines.zh: 而那些曾吞没星光的黑洞，
lines.en: And the black holes that once swallowed starlight

lines.zh: 也终将一点点蒸发，归于消逝。
lines.en: will at last evaporate, bit by bit, and pass away.
